findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 33 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 19 questions numbered 1-19; by section: 33.1 3, 33.2 1, 33.3 6, 33.4 1, 33.5 2, 33.6 3, 33.7 2, 33.8 1.

Theory parts cover the properties of water (thermal stability, solvent ability, amphoteric nature, redox potential), DO/BOD/COD with Table 33.1, point and non-point sources, microbiological pollutants, mercury, lead and cadmium, pesticides and PCBs, eutrophication, oil and plastics, human activities, environmental effects, water treatment steps, pollution control, efficient use of water and the Punjab rules. The chapter teaches no calculations, so no numerical parts. Book corrections followed (glyphosate polar, polychlorinated biphenyls, treatment step v, water shortage of the world's population).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
